name: OTP Input
description: One-time password input with auto-focus, paste support, and completion callback.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of digit boxes rendered and accepted. Example: length={4}

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled one-time code; digits fill the boxes left to right. Example: value={code}

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the accumulated code after every keystroke, paste or delete. Example: onValueChange={setCode}

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once all boxes are filled, for auto-submit. Example: onComplete={verify}

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every digit box while the code is being verified. Example: disabled={isVerifying}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the digit row. Example: className="justify-center"
